formula: MME=mean(0.5 ln((2 pi e)^3 det(C))); MPV=mean(lambda_min(C)), sample covariance; lower is locally sharper. Density/scene dependent.

overlap.note: Symmetric nearest neighbors restricted to <=1 m mutual spatial support per direction. >0.2 m is a discrepancy proxy, not a semantic wall classifier.

build.relative_time: voxel weighted mean of original scan-relative seconds

crop.note: Same GNSS XY bounding box for all runs; saved LIO-SAM GlobalMap, revoxelized in ENU at 0.1 m
